name: QuantumDiamonds

sources.quote: QuantumDiamonds GmbH, a Munich-based start-up for quantum sensor technology
The company was founded in 2022 by Dr. Kristina Liu (COO), Dr. Fleming Bruckmaier (CTO), and Kevin Berghoff (CEO)
The company was founded in 2022 by Dr. Kristina Liu (COO), Dr. Fleming Bruckmaier (CTO), and Kevin Berghoff (CEO)
A German startup spun out of a famed Munich research university whose tech helps semiconductor firms test out products and find defects has raised €15m in equity funding.
The €15 million equity round was led by climatetech investor World Fund, a new investor.
QuantumDiamonds develops and deploys next-gen semiconductor testing tools for the advanced packaging era, while offering in-house failure analysis with quantum sensing as a service.

The round was led by IQ Capital and Earlybird, who together with Onsight Ventures, First Momentum, Creator Fund, UnternehmerTUM and various angel investors from the semiconductor industry, invested EUR 3 million.
